## createConnection() function

Open a connection to the configured database.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function createConnection(config?: ConnectionConfig): Promise<Connection>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;[Connection](./database.connection.md)<!-- -->&gt;

An open connection.

## Exceptions

Error if the dialect's driver is not installed. The message names the package to add.

## Remarks

With no argument the configuration is read from the environment via [configFromEnv()](./database.configfromenv.md)<!-- -->, so the same call works across sqlite, Postgres and MySQL without any code change.

The driver is imported lazily, so only the database actually in use needs to be installed. Postgres and MySQL open a pool that stays alive until [Connection.close()](./database.connection.close.md) is called.

## Example


```ts
const connection = await createConnection()
try {
  await new Migrator(connection, { path: './migrations' }).run()
} finally {
  await connection.close()
}
```
